validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/ROUTE/CLASSIFICATION confirmed by 2 independent sources, both traced from the sheet's own gem.wiki citation pool (harvested pool had 2 URLs; both opened). (1) youm7.com news article (2019-05-26, 'Everything you need to know about the implementation of petroleum-products pipeline expansions in Upper Egypt'), reporting EGPC's own list of completed/in-progress product-line projects, item 12: 'الانتهاء من إنشاء خط التبين حتى محطة كهرباء جنوب حلوان بطول 86 كم' = 'completion of construction of the El-Tebeen line to South Helwan power station, 86 km' -- i.e. explicit, named completion of exactly this route (note: the raw HTML spells it التبين with ت, not ط -- the url_verifier check in the worklist used the wrong glyph and produced a false 'value not present' result; re-ran with the correct spelling + 'حلوان' and it passes). Same article's numbered list independently corroborates 3 sibling roster rows built off the same El-Tibeen hub node -- item 5 = P7334 (El-Tibeen-Assiut, 376 km, 3,000 t/d, matches exactly), item 10 = P7321 (Sokhna-El-Tibeen, 115 km), item 13 = P7343 (South Helwan-Bani Harun, 36 km, under construction) -- which cross-checks the whole cluster and confirms P7335 is a DISTINCT physical line from all three, not a duplicate/relabel of any of them. (2) egpc.com.eg/InProgOperProj.aspx (EGPC's own official 'Operation Projects (In Progress)' page, primary/institutional source, still live), listing under a PPC pipelines-upgrade program: 'Tebbin / South Helwan power station PL 16"/83 km' -- independently names the same two endpoints and matches GEM's Diameter=16in EXACTLY. Diameter and route/existence are therefore HIGH tier (2 independent, agreeing sources, one of them the operator's own site). PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Oil products (only) and Status=operating are all consistent with both sources (a completed products pipeline feeding a power station) and were already correctly cited to the live youm7 URL -- no change needed there. CAVEAT (not treated as a material spec conflict): length is reported slightly differently across all three sources -- GEM 87.00 km, youm7 86 km, EGPC 83 km -- a <5% spread typical of segment-boundary/rounding differences between an operator's own project list and a later news recap; not flagged as a spec concern given the tight, mutually-consistent range and the exact diameter match. Owner1=Egyptian General Petroleum Corp 100% is a reasonable state-ownership attribution (EGPC is the parent NOC; PPC, named as the executing entity on the EGPC page, is an EGPC-group operating subsidiary, not a separate owner) -- not flagged.

Neither independent source found in this audit states an explicit start/in-service year, but both are directionally inconsistent with 2017: the EGPC page (an 'In Progress Operation Project' listing, i.e. not-yet-complete as of its snapshot) still shows this same 16in/83km Tebbin-South Helwan line as a pipelines-UPGRADE project underway, and the youm7 article -- dated 2019-05-26 -- reports its construction as just having been completed ('الانتهاء من إنشاء...'). Read together this points to completion around 2018-2019, not 2017; not certain enough to propose a replacement value outright (no source gives an explicit year), so leaving StartYear1 as UNRESOLVED/flagged rather than silently passing it or fabricating a corrected year.
